title: Three Aprils and One Short Note
subtitle: 健康医疗 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 健康医疗（人与自我·生活与学习·健康的生活方式、个人安全与自救）
meta: 主题语境：健康医疗（人与自我·生活与学习·健康的生活方式、个人安全与自救）　|　核心词汇：illness　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 illness 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1974 the nurse ① treated the illness that no carer in the centre would have recorded, and he said the treating was the whole of the April. The ② illness, meaning the weakness itself and not the note, ran three Aprils and stayed unrecorded in the book; a illness, he said, is the only thing in a centre that is judged by how long it is left unrecorded.

Every ③ illness in that centre had the same short note beside it, and the ④ illness at the far chair, meaning the fever they kept for the children to understand and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A illness, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to record; the nurse said the recording is the part that fills three Aprils.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the illness was the whole of the matter, meaning the struggle and not the weakness. The ⑥ illness, meaning the struggle and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody records; illness, he said, is either something you treat or the only word that means both a weakness and a struggle. He said the struggle is the part they remember.

By 1979 the ⑦ illness had become a line in a card, and the card had become an argument about the short note. The ⑧ illness of the whole thing, the nurse wrote in May, was one centre and three Aprils of recording; illness, he said, is either the fever at the far chair or the reason you learned to record. He said the recording was never mentioned.

The ⑨ illness I remember is the weakness recorded in the card, which closed in 1981 and is still recorded as the quietest in the centre. A ⑩ illness, my mother said in 1983, is the only weakness that improves by being recorded; every illness, she said, is a struggle that has agreed to look like a weakness. She said the struggle was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 疾病；身体不适（指康复中心里每一场旁边的那一场）
B. n. 疾病；身体不适（指那场病痛本身，与便条相对）
C. 固定搭配：treat the illness 医治这场病
D. n. 疾病；身体不适（指留给孩子们读懂的那一场）
E. n. 病事（抽象总称，指一处康复中心的疾病之事）
F. n. 疾病；身体不适（指病历卡里写到、被记下的的那一场）
G. n. 抗争、煎熬（指一件事里人人都扛却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 煎熬（抽象总称，指人人都扛却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: treated the illness that no carer in the centre would have recorded
The illness, meaning the weakness itself and not the note
the illness at the far chair
the illness was the whole of the matter
the illness had become a line in a card
The illness of the whole thing
A illness, my mother said in 1983

answers.why: treat the illness 意为“医治这场病”，1974 年那位护士把康复中心里没有一位照护者肯记录的一场疾病做了一遍。
illness 意为“疾病；身体不适”，指那场病痛本身而不是便条，它经过了三个四月而在簿子上没有被记录。
illness 意为“疾病；身体不适”，指康复中心里每一场旁边的那一场，每一场旁边都有同一张薄薄的便条。
illness 意为“疾病；身体不适”，指最远那把椅子留给孩子们读懂的那一场，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
illness 意为“抗争、煎熬”，指一件事里人人都扛却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这场抗争就是那件事的全部。
illness 意为“煎熬”，指人人都扛却无人提起的那样东西而不是那场病痛，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
illness 意为“疾病；身体不适”，指病历卡里写到、被记下的的那一场，到 1979 年这一场成了病历卡里的一行。
illness 意为“病事”，护士五月写道，整件事的疾病之事是一处康复中心和三个四月的记录。
illness 意为“疾病；身体不适”，我记得的是病历卡里记录过的那一场，1981 年好转了，至今仍被说成康复中心里最安静的一场。
illness 为抽象总称，母亲 1983 年说，疾病是唯一会因为被好好记录而变得更好的病痛。
